title: File a leave request from chat
goal: Submit a leave request conversationally and get it routed for approval.
solution: Chat flow in the HR portal collects the leave details, validates them against the entitlement service and files the request through the existing approval API.
deliverables: Chat flow covering the request, edit and cancel paths
Integration with the approval API, including the audit trail
acceptanceCriteria: 90 % of requests filed without falling back to the form
assumptions: The entitlement service exposes balances through its existing API
